Acharya’s summary of the Mānasāra, the Sanskrit treatise on architecture and sculpture, with its chapters on towns, houses, temples and images (1918). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Summary Of The Manasara · Acharya, Prasanna Kumar · 1918, 96 scanned pages. Published 1918; Prasanna Kumar Acharya died 1946; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
